"""NovaTTS launcher.

Run from anywhere inside the repo:

    python run.py

or

    python -m novatts.main          (from the backend/ directory)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import uvicorn

# Make the backend/ directory importable when run as a plain script.
BACKEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if str(BACKEND_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND_DIR))

from novatts.config import settings  # noqa: E402


def _run() -> None:
    import argparse

    from novatts.logconf import setup_logging
    from novatts.main import app as _app

    # Uvicorn's default log config only wires up its OWN loggers; the
    # app loggers (novatts.*) would stay at WARNING. Enable them at the
    # configured level so log.info(...)/log.debug(...) reach the console.
    setup_logging()

    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--host", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--port", default=None)
    a, _ = p.parse_known_args()
    host = a.host or settings.host
    try:
        port = int(a.port) if a.port is not None else settings.port
    except Exception:
        port = settings.port
    print(f"NovaTTS starting on http://{host}:{port}")
    uvicorn.run(_app, host=host, port=port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    _run()

    "speakers.json",
    "emotion_sound_map.json.example",
    "emotion_aliases.json.example",

block_cipher = None

# -*- mode: python ; coding: utf-8 -*-
from pathlib import Path

# Analysis/PYZ/EXE are injected into the spec namespace by PyInstaller.
# SPECPATH is the directory of this spec file (backend/), provided by PyInstaller.
BACKEND_DIR = Path(SPECPATH).resolve()

# Only the shared defaults belong in the bundle. Anything describing the local
# audio library or a local game is left out on purpose: emotion_sound_map.json,
# emotion_aliases.json, perfect_cut.json and games/*/speakers.json are personal
# runtime data, gitignored, and the app recreates them on first run. Bundling
function Stage-BackendExe {
    if (Test-Done 'BackendExe') { Write-Ck "Backend-exe al gebouwd - overslaan"; return }

    $py = "$ROOT/backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"
    if (-not (Test-Path $py)) {
        Write-Ck "Geen backend/.venv - maak Python 3.11 venv + deps..."
        python -m venv '$ROOT/backend/.venv' | Out-Null
        & "$py" -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel setuptools 2>&1 | Out-String | Add-Content $LOG
        & "$py" -m pip install -r '$ROOT/backend/requirements.txt' 2>&1 | Out-String | Add-Content $LOG
        Write-Ck "venv + requirements geinstalleerd"
    } else { Write-Ck "backend/.venv bestaat al" }

    # Freeze from the live spec in backend/. Never reuse the scaffolded
    # payload spec: it can be months old and would ship stale API routes.
    $spec = "$ROOT/backend/Novabackend.spec"
    if (-not (Test-Path $spec)) { throw "PyInstaller-spec ontbreekt: $spec" }

    # Freeze (kan 5-15 min duren). PyInstaller must be awaited: the old
    # Process.Start variant returned immediately and checked for the exe
    # before it existed.
    Write-Ck "PyInstaller-freeze: backend/Novabackend.spec ..."
    Push-Location "$ROOT/backend"
    try {
        & $py -m PyInstaller $spec --noconfirm --distpath "$ROOT/backend/dist" --workpath "$ROOT/backend/build" 2>&1 |
            Out-String | Add-Content $LOG
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "PyInstaller faalde (exit $LASTEXITCODE). Zie log: $LOG" }
    } finally { Pop-Location }

    $exe = "$ROOT/backend/dist/novatts-backend.exe"
    if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { throw "novatts-backend.exe niet gegenereerd in backend\dist\" }
    Write-Ck "PyInstaller completed successfully: $exe ($((Get-Item $exe).Length) bytes)"

    # Plaats in payload resources/
    $destExe = "$CK/payload/resources/novatts-backend.exe"
    Copy-Item $exe $destExe -Force

    assert "/auto-forward/toggle" in paths
    assert "/auto-forward/capture" in paths
    assert "/auto-forward/windows" in paths

## Objective
- Fix the NovaTTS auto-forward setting that was non-responsive and showed `Auto-forward status unavailable: 404 Not Found: {"detail":"Not Found"}`.
- The user now reports a regression after that fix: "The GUI is now not functioning at all. No qwen, no sample voices, no gameids etc." with health endpoints `http://127.0.0.1:8765/health {"status":"ok","qwen":true}` and `http://127.0.0.1:8080/health {"status":"ok"}`.

## Requirements
- Use the running installed app, not just the repo.
- Keep existing build/packaging conventions.

## Decisions
- Root cause of the original 404: installed backend exe was stale (`C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\NovaTTS\resources\novatts-backend.exe`, built Oct 25) and only had `/auto-forward/status`, `/auto-forward/config`; the GUI called `/auto-forward` and `POST /auto-forward`.
- Fix by making the backend support both old and new auto-forward routes, rebuilding the exe, and deploying it to the installed app.
- Also fixed the broken PyInstaller spec and the build script's backend stage so future builds cannot silently ship stale API routes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Edited `backend/novatts/main.py`:
  - `from .auto_forward import HOTKEY_OPTIONS, AutoForward`
  - `AutoForwardBody` now accepts `hotkey`
  - Added `_auto_forward_status()` returning status plus `hotkey_options`
  - Registered both `GET /auto-forward` and `GET /auto-forward/status`
  - Registered both `POST /auto-forward` and `POST /auto-forward/config`
  - `capture`, `toggle`, `set` use the shared status helper
- Added `backend/tests/test_auto_forward_api.py`; passes (`2 passed`) and ruff passes.
- Fixed `backend/Novabackend.spec`: removed broken `PyInstaller.building.api` import and switched to `BACKEND_DIR = Path(SPECPATH).resolve()`.
- Rebuilt `backend/dist/novatts-backend.exe` successfully (39,298,759 bytes, hash prefix `3772CFF19F01A93D`).
- Verified new exe on spare port 8766: `/auto-forward`, `/auto-forward/status`, `/auto-forward/windows` all returned 200; status includes `available:true`, `hotkey_options`.
- Deployed exe to `C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\NovaTTS\resources\novatts-backend.exe` and `.build\2.5.0d\payload\resources\novatts-backend.exe`.
- Copied updated `backend/novatts/main.py` to `C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\NovaTTS\backend\novatts\main.py`.
- Restarted NovaTTS; installed backend now returns `/auto-forward` 200 and POST works.
- Reset test target/delay to empty / `1.0`.
- Fixed `.dev/Build-2.5.0d.ps1`:
  - `Stage-BackendExe` now uses live `backend/Novabackend.spec`, awaits PyInstaller, checks exit code, outputs to `backend/dist`.
  - `Stage-Version` reads/writes BOM-free UTF-8 to avoid mojibake.
  - Script parses with 0 errors.
- Fixed `gui/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`: removed BOM and repaired `Perfect Cut — NovaTTS Sample Cutно` mojibake; diff now only shows version `2.0.0` → `2.5.0d`.
- Confirmed current backend actually serves full data: `/status`, `/qwen/status`, `/games`, `/voices`, `/speakers`, `/settings`, `/emotions` all 200 with Qwen online, 90 voices, 58 speakers, 52 games.

### Active
- Diagnosing why the GUI displays no qwen / no sample voices / no game IDs even though backend endpoints return full data.
- Discovered installed app version metadata: WebView2 command shows `--webview-exe-version=2.0.0`, user data `C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\net.novatts.gui\EBWebView`; installed `NovaTTS.exe` is Oct 28 and matches `.build/payload-2.5.0c/NovaTTS.exe` hash `C8DFBAA670FC48CB`.
- Remote debugging attempt with `WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS=--remote-debugging-port=9222` did not open port 9222.
- Two `novatts-backend.exe` processes running (`3452`, `15880`); only `15880` listens on 8765. One may be a duplicate/orphan.
- Vite dev server is running on port 1420 from `D:\Projects\NovaTTS`; installed Tauri app may or may not be loading it.

### Blocked
- Cannot yet inspect GUI console/network; WebView2 remote debugging port did not appear.
- Unclear whether installed GUI frontend expects current or older API shapes for games/voices/qwen.

## Next Move
1. Determine what frontend the running installed GUI actually loads (embedded assets vs. Vite dev server at 1420), e.g. inspect WebView2 process target/user-data or enable CDP another way.
2. Compare the installed GUI's expected API responses against current backend; especially `/status`, `/games`, `/voices`, `/qwen/status`, `/speakers`.
3. Consider running the old backend exe from `.build/payload-2.5.0c/resources/novatts-backend.exe` on a spare port and diffing response shapes to see what changed.
4. If the installed GUI is stale Oct 28 build and incompatible with current backend, rebuild/install the GUI or add compatibility to backend.
5. Investigate the duplicate `novatts-backend.exe` process and clean up orphans.
6. After fix, verify the GUI shows Qwen, voices, games, and that auto-forward toggle is enabled.

## Relevant Files
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\backend\novatts\main.py`: auto-forward endpoints, compatibility aliases, status helper.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\backend\Novabackend.spec`: fixed PyInstaller spec.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\backend\novatts\auto_forward.py`: Windows Win32 implementation; `HOTKEY_OPTIONS`, `status()`, `list_windows()`.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\gui\src\lib\api.ts`: frontend API base `http://127.0.0.1:8765`; endpoint calls.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\gui\src\lib\components\SettingsPanel.svelte`: auto-forward UI; checkbox disabled when `!af?.available`.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\.dev\Build-2.5.0d.ps1`: fixed backend/GUI build stages.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\backend\tests\test_auto_forward_api.py`: new route-contract test.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\gui\src-tauri\src\lib.rs`: `spawn_backend`, backend readiness check on 8765/8081, shutdown, resource path.
- `C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\NovaTTS\NovaTTS.exe`: installed GUI (Oct 28, version metadata 2.0.0).
- `C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\NovaTTS\resources\novatts-backend.exe`: deployed new backend.
- `C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\NovaTTS\backend\.env`: active backend config (`NOVATTS_PORT=8765`, `NOVATTS_QWEN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080`, data paths).
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\.build\payload-2.5.0c\resources\novatts-backend.exe`: old backend (hash `93F166742CEBA42D`) useful for comparison.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\.build\2.5.0d\payload\resources\novatts-backend.exe`: updated payload backend.

## Important Context
- Installed GUI is older than current repo source; repo `gui/src/lib/api.ts` uses `/auto-forward`, while old backend supported `/auto-forward/status` and `/auto-forward/config`.
- New backend now supports both route families, so auto-forward 404 should be gone.
- Current backend responses are complete: `/status` reports `"qwen":true`, `"games":[...]`, `"voices":[...]`, `"speaker_count":58`; `/games` returns 52 games; `/voices` returns 90; `/speakers` returns 58.
- Backend data dir appears correct: `C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\NovaTTS` (base), env file `...\backend\.env`.
- Backend is configured `NOVATTS_HOST=127.0.0.1`, `NOVATTS_PORT=8765`; Qwen is external on 8080.
- The GUI may have loaded before backend was healthy and cached empty state, but this is unconfirmed.
- PowerShell alias issue: use `curl.exe`, not `curl` (which maps to `Invoke-WebRequest`).
- Repo has uncommitted changes: `backend/Novabackend.spec`, `backend/novatts/main.py`, `gui/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`; untracked `.dev/Build-2.5.0d.ps1`, `backend/tests/test_auto_forward_api.py`, `build/`, `installer/NovaTTS-2.5.0d.iss`, `run.spec`.
- No commits pushed.

Actually let me think about the most likely cause: the GUI is loading from Vite dev server at 1420 (dev mode) while the installed exe is a dev build. But user says "GUI is now not functioning at all" after the fix. Possibly the GUI is loading Vite dev server pointed at repo source, and repo `api.ts` calls `/auto-forward`, and the backend... no, backend now supports both.

Wait — maybe the issue: backend has two processes; port 8765 owned by 9688. But GUI might be spawning its own backend that fails to bind. Hmm, but GUI health check `backend_running()` checks port 8765; if already running it skips spawn.

Let me actually check the installed app's assets. Tauri embeds frontend into the exe... but the probe found no "/games" as plain text, likely because assets are compressed (Tauri v2 uses brotli compression by default in `tauri.conf.json`? Actually there's `"frontendDist"` and embedded assets are compressed with brotli). So can't grep.

Better: take a screenshot / inspect using CDP. Remote debugging didn't work via env var. Alternative: use Tauri's devtools? Or check if GUI loads 1420 by looking at network connections of NovaTTS process.

Let me check TCP connections from NovaTTS.exe to port 1420 vs not.

Requests to http://127.0.0.1:8765 from origin http://tauri.localhost — if CORS isn't allowed, fetch fails → everything offline. That would explain "no qwen, no voices, no games". And the auto-forward status 404 earlier: wait, if CORS blocked, the error would be "Failed to fetch", not 404. So CORS was working earlier (auto-forward status unavailable 404). Hmm.

Found it — and it wasn't the auto-forward code at all.

## Root cause

The packaged GUI runs from `http://tauri.localhost/` (Windows WebView2), but the backend only allowed `https://tauri.localhost`:

```
allow_origins=[..., "tauri://localhost", "https://tauri.localhost"]
allow_origin_regex=r"https://.*\.tauri\.local.*"
```

So the browser blocked **every** response: health, `/status`, `/games`, `/voices`, `/speakers`, `/auto-forward`. The UI just rendered its empty/offline state (`QWEN offline`, no voices, no game IDs, `SPEAKERS .`), while the backend was perfectly healthy on the wire. Earlier you saw a real 404 because that session was the dev GUI at `http://localhost:1420`, which *is* allowed.

## Fix

`backend/novatts/main.py`:
- added `http://tauri.localhost` to `allow_origins`
- widened the regex to `https?://(?:[\w-]+\.)*tauri\.local(?:host)?(?::\d+)?`

Added `backend/tests/test_cors_origins.py` (allowed origins + preflight + reject unknown origin). Rebuilt the frozen backend, deployed it, and restarted the app.

## Verified on the running installed app

- `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://tauri.localhost` on `GET /status` and on preflight
- GUI (via UI Automation): `ok` · `QWEN online` · `SPEAKERS 58` · active game `BeingADIK-0.8.3-pc` · voices import `90 found – 90 pairs` · live log receiving `dialogue/queued` events
- `GET /auto-forward` → `available: true`, `hotkey_options` present, and Enable / target / Capture / Test controls are all enabled

- `backend/novatts/main.py` (CORS)
- `backend/tests/test_cors_origins.py` (new)

"""Central configuration for NovaTTS."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

# Windows installs keep the Qwen engine + models under the per-user AI-Tools
# build (<LOCALAPPDATA>\NovaTTS\AI-Tools). Derive those defaults from the
# environment instead of hardcoding a developer machine; on Linux the paths
# stay empty, which the rest of the code already treats as "not set / auto".
_WIN = sys.platform.startswith("win32")


def _dir_is_writable(path: Path) -> bool:
    """True when we can create files in ``path`` (creates it if needed)."""
    try:
        path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        probe = path / ".novatts-write-test"
        probe.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        probe.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False


def _user_data_dir() -> Path:
    """XDG data dir used by installed Linux builds."""
    xdg = os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME", "").strip()
    root = Path(xdg) if xdg else Path.home() / ".local" / "share"
    return root / "novatts"


def _base_dir() -> Path:
    # Explicit override (launcher/diagnostics).
    if env_base := os.environ.get("NOVATTS_BASE_DIR"):
        return Path(env_base).resolve()

    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        exe_dir = Path(sys.executable).resolve().parent
        # Dev layout: the exe lives under <repo>\gui\src-tauri\target\...\resources
        # (or backend\dist). Walk up until we find the repo root (a directory
        # containing both `data` and `backend`). That keeps the frozen exe and
        # the `start_all.cmd` python backend on the SAME data dir, so speakers
        # and games never "split" across a second location depending on which
        # launch method was used.
        cur = exe_dir
        for _ in range(6):
            if (cur / "data").is_dir() and (cur / "backend").is_dir():
                return cur
            parent = cur.parent
            if parent == cur:
                break
            cur = parent
        # Installed-layout fallbacks (no repo root around).
        installed: list[Path] = []
        if exe_dir.name.lower() == "resources":
            installed.append(exe_dir.parent)
        if (exe_dir / "data").exists() or (exe_dir / "backend").exists():
            installed.append(exe_dir)
        if (exe_dir.parent / "data").exists():
            installed.append(exe_dir.parent)
        for cand in installed:
            if _dir_is_writable(cand):

        # Writing speakers/cache there fails, so keep user state in XDG_DATA_HOME.
        if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
            return _user_data_dir()
        return installed[0] if installed else exe_dir
    # Source layout (python run.py in backend/): repo root.
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent

    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        base = _base_dir()
        cand = base / "backend"
        if cand.exists():
            return cand
        return base
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

DATA_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data"
BACKEND_DIR = _backend_dir()

    """Default path inside <LOCALAPPDATA>\\NovaTTS\\AI-Tools\\qwentts.cpp."""
    if not _WIN:

    if not local:

===== .dev/Write-NovaTTSEnv.ps1 =====
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Writes (or repairs) the NovaTTS .env so the Qwen paths point at the
    AI-Tools build under %LOCALAPPDATA%\NovaTTS\AI-Tools.

.NOTES
    - Writes UTF-8 WITHOUT BOM: a BOM makes python-dotenv prefix the first
      key with U+FEFF, so that setting is silently ignored.
    - Preserves unrelated keys and comments.
    - Repairs only known-broken values; a user's custom paths are kept.
    - ASCII-only strings to avoid Windows encoding/parse errors.
#>

param(
    [string]$Root = (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'NovaTTS'),
    [switch]$Force
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# The app reads .env next to itself ({app}); the AI-Tools build always lives
# under %LOCALAPPDATA%\NovaTTS\AI-Tools (spaces-free path for CMake).
$root     = $Root
$aiHome   = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'NovaTTS\AI-Tools'
$qwen     = Join-Path $aiHome 'qwentts.cpp'
$bin      = Join-Path $qwen 'build\Release\tts-server.exe'
$codecBin = Join-Path $qwen 'build\Release\qwen-codec.exe'
$model    = Join-Path $qwen 'models\qwen-talker-1.7b-base-Q8_0.gguf'
$tok      = Join-Path $qwen 'models\qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf'
$samples  = Join-Path $root 'data\samples'

try { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $samples -Force | Out-Null } catch {}

# Ordered so the file reads top-to-bottom in a sensible order.
$keys = [ordered]@{
    'NOVATTS_HOST'                      = '127.0.0.1'
    'NOVATTS_PORT'                      = '8765'
    'NOVATTS_QWEN_URL'                  = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
    'NOVATTS_QWEN_BIN'                  = $bin
    'NOVATTS_QWEN_MODEL'                = $model
    # tts-server --codec expects the tokenizer GGUF, NOT qwen-codec.exe.
    'NOVATTS_QWEN_CODEC'                = $tok
    # qwen-codec.exe is the separate .spk/.rvq extractor binary.
    'NOVATTS_QWEN_CODEC_BIN'            = $codecBin
    'NOVATTS_QWEN_AUTOSTART'            = '1'
    'NOVATTS_QWEN_AUTO_IMPORT_SAMPLES'  = '1'
    'NOVATTS_QWEN_SAMPLES_DIR'          = $samples
}

$targets = @(
    (Join-Path $root '.env'),
    (Join-Path $root 'backend\.env')
)

foreach ($envPath in $targets) {
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $envPath
    if ($dir) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }

    $lines = @()
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $envPath) {
        $lines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $envPath -Encoding UTF8)
        if ($lines.Count -gt 0 -and $lines[0].Length -gt 0 -and $lines[0][0] -eq [char]0xFEFF) {
            $lines[0] = $lines[0].Substring(1)
        }
    }

    $list = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $list.Add([string]$line) }

    foreach ($key in $keys.Keys) {
        $value = [string]$keys[$key]
        $found = $false
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $list.Count; $i++) {
            if ($list[$i] -match ('^\s*' + [regex]::Escape($key) + '\s*=')) {
                $current = ($list[$i] -replace '^\s*[^=]+\s*=\s*', '').Trim().Trim('"')
                $repair = $false
                if ($Force) {
                    $repair = $true
                } elseif ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($current)) {
                    $repair = $true
                } elseif ($key -in @('NOVATTS_QWEN_BIN', 'NOVATTS_QWEN_CODEC_BIN') -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $value)) {
                    # Engine binaries are version-locked to the AI-Tools build,
                    # so always use the installed copy when it exists.
                    $repair = $true
                } elseif ($key -in @('NOVATTS_QWEN_BIN', 'NOVATTS_QWEN_MODEL', 'NOVATTS_QWEN_CODEC', 'NOVATTS_QWEN_CODEC_BIN', 'NOVATTS_QWEN_SAMPLES_DIR') -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $current)) {
                    # Stale path from another machine/drive (e.g. an old E:\
                    # model location) - replace it with the install path.
                    $repair = $true
                } elseif ($key -eq 'NOVATTS_QWEN_CODEC' -and $current -match '(?i)\.exe$') {
                    $repair = $true
                } elseif ($key -eq 'NOVATTS_QWEN_CODEC_BIN' -and $current -match '(?i)Program Files') {
                    $repair = $true
                } elseif ($key -eq 'NOVATTS_QWEN_AUTOSTART' -and $current -eq '0') {
                    $repair = $true
                }
                if ($repair) { $list[$i] = "$key=$value" }
                $found = $true
                break
            }
        }
        if (-not $found) { $list.Add("$key=$value") }
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($envPath, $list, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Write-Host "[NovaTTS] Wrote $envPath"
}

Write-Host "[NovaTTS] Qwen bin: $bin"

===== backend/setup_qwen.py =====
"""Download Qwen3-TTS GGUF models and start the tts-server.

Requires: pip install huggingface_hub  (or use hf download via HF CLI)
Downloads to D:\\Projects\\qwentts.cpp\\models  (pre-converted GGUFs).

Usage:
  .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe setup_qwen.py --variant 1.7b-customvoice
  .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe setup_qwen.py --variant 0.6b-customvoice   # lighter, less VRAM
  .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe setup_qwen.py --check                      # only check what's present
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

QWENTTS = Path(r"D:\Projects\qwentts.cpp")
MODELS = QWENTTS / "models"

REPOS = {
    "tokenizer": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
    "0.6b-base": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
    "0.6b-customvoice": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
    "1.7b-base": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
    "1.7b-customvoice": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
}

NEEDED = {
    "0.6b-customvoice": [
        "qwen-talker-0.6b-customvoice-Q8_0.gguf",
        "qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf",
    ],
    "1.7b-customvoice": [
        "qwen-talker-1.7b-customvoice-Q8_0.gguf",
        "qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf",
    ],
    "0.6b-base": ["qwen-talker-0.6b-base-Q8_0.gguf", "qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf"],
    "1.7b-base": ["qwen-talker-1.7b-base-Q8_0.gguf", "qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf"],
}


def check(variant: str) -> bool:
    need = NEEDED.get(variant, [])
    ok = True
    for name in need:
        p = MODELS / name
        print(f"  {'OK' if p.exists() else 'MISSING'} {name} ({p})")
        if not p.exists():
            ok = False
    return ok


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--variant", default="1.7b-customvoice", choices=list(NEEDED))
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="Only check")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if not MODELS.exists():
        MODELS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"Models dir: {MODELS}")
    if check(args.variant):
        print("All required GGUFs present.")
    else:
        print(f"Missing files for {args.variant}. Download with one of:")
        print(f"  hf download Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF --local-dir {MODELS}")
        print(f"  python -m huggingface_hub.cli download Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF --local-dir {MODELS}")
        print("Or run checkpoints.sh/convert.py per qwentts.cpp README.")
        if args.check:
            return 1
        try:
            import huggingface_hub  # noqa: F401
        except ImportError:
            print("Installing huggingface_hub ...")
            subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "huggingface_hub"])
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download

        snapshot_download(
            repo_id="Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
            local_dir=str(MODELS),
            local_dir_use_symlinks=False,
        )
        check(args.variant)

    print("\nStart the engine:")
    need = NEEDED[args.variant]
    print(f'  {QWENTTS / "build" / "Release" / "tts-server.exe"} --model {MODELS / need[0]} --codec {MODELS / need[1]} --port 8081')
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def _default_qwentts_dir() -> Path:

"""Download Qwen3-TTS GGUF models and start the tts-server.

Requires: pip install huggingface_hub  (or use hf download via HF CLI)

The target directory is derived from the configured engine (``NOVATTS_QWEN_BIN``
/ ``NOVATTS_QWEN_MODEL``) or, when nothing is configured yet, from the AI-tools
install location (``%LOCALAPPDATA%\\NovaTTS\\AI-Tools\\qwentts.cpp``). Override
with ``--qwentts-dir`` / ``--models-dir``.

Usage:
  .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe setup_qwen.py --variant 1.7b-customvoice
  .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe setup_qwen.py --variant 0.6b-customvoice   # lighter, less VRAM
  .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe setup_qwen.py --check                      # only check what's present
  .\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe setup_qwen.py --models-dir "D:\\models"
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPOS = {
    "tokenizer": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
    "0.6b-base": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
    "0.6b-customvoice": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
    "1.7b-base": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
    "1.7b-customvoice": "Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
}

NEEDED = {
    "0.6b-customvoice": [
        "qwen-talker-0.6b-customvoice-Q8_0.gguf",
        "qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf",
    ],
    "1.7b-customvoice": [
        "qwen-talker-1.7b-customvoice-Q8_0.gguf",
        "qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf",
    ],
    "0.6b-base": ["qwen-talker-0.6b-base-Q8_0.gguf", "qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf"],
    "1.7b-base": ["qwen-talker-1.7b-base-Q8_0.gguf", "qwen-tokenizer-12hz-Q8_0.gguf"],
}


def _configured() -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Current engine/model paths from the backend config, if available."""
    try:
        from novatts.config import settings
    except Exception:
        return "", ""
    return settings.qwen_bin or "", settings.qwen_model or ""


def default_qwentts_dir() -> Path:
    """Engine checkout: <dir>\\build\\Release\\tts-server.exe lives under it."""
    qwen_bin, _ = _configured()
    if qwen_bin:
        exe = Path(qwen_bin)
        # ...\qwentts.cpp\build\Release\tts-server.exe -> ...\qwentts.cpp
        if exe.parent.name.lower() == "release" and exe.parent.parent.name.lower() == "build":
            return exe.parent.parent.parent
        return exe.parent
    local = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "").strip()
    if local:
        return Path(local) / "NovaTTS" / "AI-Tools" / "qwentts.cpp"
    return Path.cwd() / "qwentts.cpp"


def default_models_dir(qwentts: Path) -> Path:
    _, model = _configured()
    if model:
        return Path(model).parent
    return qwentts / "models"


def check(models: Path, variant: str) -> bool:
    need = NEEDED.get(variant, [])
    ok = True
    for name in need:
        p = models / name
        print(f"  {'OK' if p.exists() else 'MISSING'} {name} ({p})")
        if not p.exists():
            ok = False
    return ok


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--variant", default="1.7b-customvoice", choices=list(NEEDED))
    ap.add_argument("--qwentts-dir", default="", help="qwentts.cpp checkout (default: configured/installed)")
    ap.add_argument("--models-dir", default="", help="Model directory (default: <qwentts>/models)")
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="Only check")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    qwentts = Path(args.qwentts_dir) if args.qwentts_dir else default_qwentts_dir()
    models = Path(args.models_dir) if args.models_dir else default_models_dir(qwentts)

    models.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"Qwen root: {qwentts}")
    print(f"Models dir: {models}")
    if check(models, args.variant):
        print("All required GGUFs present.")
    else:
        print(f"Missing files for {args.variant}. Download with one of:")
        print(f"  hf download Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF --local-dir {models}")
        print(f"  python -m huggingface_hub.cli download Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF --local-dir {models}")
        print("Or run checkpoints.sh/convert.py per qwentts.cpp README.")
        if args.check:
            return 1
        try:
            import huggingface_hub  # noqa: F401
        except ImportError:
            print("Installing huggingface_hub ...")
            subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "huggingface_hub"])
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download

        snapshot_download(
            repo_id="Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF",
            local_dir=str(models),
            local_dir_use_symlinks=False,
        )
        check(models, args.variant)

    print("\nStart the engine:")
    need = NEEDED[args.variant]
    print(f'  {qwentts / "build" / "Release" / "tts-server.exe"} --model {models / need[0]} --codec {models / need[1]} --port 8081')
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

function Get-NovaEnv([string]$Name, [string]$Default = "") {
    $v = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($Name)
    if ($v) { return $v }
    foreach ($f in @((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '.env'), (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'NovaTTS\.env'))) {
        if (Test-Path $f) {

        }
    }
    return $Default
}

## Objective
- Fix the NovaTTS GUI regression where it showed no Qwen status, no sample voices, and no game IDs, after an earlier auto-forward 404 fix.

## Requirements
- Use the running installed app, not just the repo, to verify fixes.
- Keep existing build/packaging conventions.

## Decisions
- Root cause of the GUI regression: CORS origin mismatch. Packaged Windows WebView2 loads the frontend from `http://tauri.localhost/`, but backend allowed only `https://tauri.localhost`, so all browser responses were blocked (UI silently fell back to empty/offline state).
- Earlier auto-forward 404 came from the dev GUI origin `http://localhost:1420` (allowed), which is why that session could read a real 404 body.
- Fixed CORS rather than changing the frontend origin.
- Earlier auto-forward fix (dual route families) kept as-is; both `/auto-forward` and `/auto-forward/status|config` are registered.

## Work State
### Completed
- `backend/novatts/main.py`: added `http://tauri.localhost` to `allow_origins`; widened regex to `https?://(?:[\w-]+\.)*tauri\.local(?:host)?(?::\d+)?`.
- Added `backend/tests/test_cors_origins.py` (allowed origins incl. preflight, unknown origin rejected).
- Rebuilt `backend/dist/novatts-backend.exe` (39,299,111 bytes, SHA256 prefix `381B2DFE45A214F2`).

- Verified new exe on spare port 8766: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://tauri.localhost` on GET and preflight (OPTIONS).
- Restarted installed app and verified via UI Automation: `ok`, `QWEN online`, `SPEAKERS 58`, active game `BeingADIK-0.8.3-pc`, voices import `90 found - 90 pairs`, live log receiving `dialogue`/`queued` events.
- `GET /auto-forward` returns `available: true` with `hotkey_options`; Enable / target / Capture / Test controls are enabled.
- Test suite: 257 passed, 2 failed (`tests/test_openai_speech.py` only; pre-existing env issue — `ffmpeg` missing, HTTP 502, `WinError 2`).
- Ruff clean on changed files.
- Earlier completed: auto-forward dual routes + `backend/tests/test_auto_forward_api.py`; fixed `backend/Novabackend.spec`; fixed `.dev/Build-2.5.0d.ps1` backend/version stages; repaired mojibake/BOM in `gui/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` (version now `2.5.0d`).

- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\backend\novatts\main.py`: CORS config (line ~577) and auto-forward routes.
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\backend\tests\test_cors_origins.py`: new CORS contract test.

- `C:\Users\BoBo\AppData\Local\NovaTTS\backend\.env`: active backend config (`NOVATTS_PORT=8765`, `NOVATTS_QWEN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080`).
- `D:\Projects\NovaTTS\.build\2.5.0d\payload\resources\novatts-backend.exe`: updated installer payload backend.

"""First-run setup must never propose paths from someone else's machine.

``/setup/defaults`` exists so the GUI can suggest the AI-Tools install that
ships with NovaTTS. It has to come from the *compiled* defaults, because a
stale ``.env`` (or a developer checkout) may still contain a path like
``E:\\LLM's\\...`` that does not exist for a new user.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from novatts.config import Settings, settings
from novatts.main import app

PATH_FIELDS = ("qwen_bin", "qwen_model", "qwen_codec", "qwen_codec_bin", "qwen_samples_dir")


def test_every_setup_path_field_is_reported() -> None:
    res = TestClient(app).get("/setup/defaults")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    body = res.json()
    assert set(body["paths"]) == set(PATH_FIELDS)
    for name, info in body["paths"].items():
        assert set(info) == {"suggested", "exists"}, name
        assert isinstance(info["suggested"], str)
        assert isinstance(info["exists"], bool)


def test_suggestions_ignore_the_live_env(monkeypatch) -> None:
    """A machine-specific path in the running config must not be suggested."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, "qwen_bin", r"E:\LLM's\somebody-elses\tts-server.exe", raising=False)

    body = TestClient(app).get("/setup/defaults").json()
    assert body["paths"]["qwen_bin"]["suggested"] != settings.qwen_bin
    assert body["paths"]["qwen_bin"]["suggested"] == str(Settings.model_fields["qwen_bin"].default)


def test_compiled_defaults_are_not_developer_paths() -> None:
    for name in ("qwen_bin", "qwen_model", "qwen_codec"):
        default = str(Settings.model_fields[name].default)
        assert not default.lower().startswith("e:"), f"{name} still points at a drive letter"
        assert "!!scripts!!" not in default.lower()
        assert "\\projects\\qwentts" not in default.lower()


def test_env_file_is_absolute() -> None:
    body = TestClient(app).get("/setup/defaults").json()
    assert Path(body["env_file"]).is_absolute()
